exposure: 500 ml of haemocoel preload before spinal anaesthesia
300mg of phenylephrine in 100ml infusion over 3 minutes
cohort: The study included 90 participants undergoing caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Phenylephrine infusion is more effective than haemocoel preload in preventing hypotension due to spinal anaesthesia during caesarean section.
mod_finding: Phenylephrine infusion is more effective than haemocoel preload in preventing hypotension during caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
